Helpful information

Frequently asked questions

Who can join CoreX?

Students from Computer Science, AI & ML, Electrical, Electronics and Mechanical Engineering are welcome to express interest.

Do I need previous project experience?

No. Curiosity, consistency, willingness to learn and responsible teamwork matter. Some roles may have practical selection tasks.

Is the Innovation Lab currently operational?

This website describes the proposed lab vision. Individual facilities should be marked operational only after they are installed, tested and authorised for use.

How do projects get selected?

Teams can submit a problem statement, proposed solution, required resources, timeline, safety considerations and expected outcomes for review.

Can companies collaborate with CoreX?

Potential partners can explore mentoring, technical sessions, equipment support and student challenges through an authorised club representative and the institute's approval process.
